problem_text:
A manufacturer needs to distribute production capacity across 19 product lines to maximize total expected profit margin.  
The specifications for each product line are as follows:  
* Product A: expected margin is 0.134, resource consumption is 0.046, capacity limits [0.068, 0.766]  
* Product B: expected margin is 0.135, resource consumption is 0.155, capacity limits [0.091, 0.631]  
* Product C: expected margin is 0.124, resource consumption is 0.300, capacity limits [0.088, 0.369]  
* Product D: expected margin is 0.027, resource consumption is 0.130, capacity limits [0.010, 0.814]  
* Product E: expected margin is 0.154, resource consumption is 0.112, capacity limits [0.009, 0.870]  
* Product F: expected margin is 0.054, resource consumption is 0.250, capacity limits [0.081, 0.510]  
* Product G: expected margin is 0.145, resource consumption is 0.133, capacity limits [0.009, 0.776]  
* Product H: expected margin is 0.159, resource consumption is 0.292, capacity limits [0.002, 0.578]  
* Product I: expected margin is 0.128, resource consumption is 0.107, capacity limits [0.090, 0.845]  
* Product J: expected margin is 0.059, resource consumption is 0.279, capacity limits [0.010, 0.687]  
* Product K: expected margin is 0.058, resource consumption is 0.143, capacity limits [0.073, 0.771]  
* Product L: expected margin is 0.054, resource consumption is 0.118, capacity limits [0.061, 0.537]  
* Product M: expected margin is 0.142, resource consumption is 0.170, capacity limits [0.053, 0.864]  
* Product N: expected margin is 0.192, resource consumption is 0.057, capacity limits [0.061, 0.769]  
* Product O: expected margin is 0.087, resource consumption is 0.136, capacity limits [0.049, 0.605]  
* Product P: expected margin is 0.085, resource consumption is 0.093, capacity limits [0.078, 0.461]  
* Product Q: expected margin is 0.074, resource consumption is 0.201, capacity limits [0.065, 0.695]  
* Product R: expected margin is 0.075, resource consumption is 0.207, capacity limits [0.083, 0.484]  
* Product S: expected margin is 0.167, resource consumption is 0.194, capacity limits [0.021, 0.842]  

Each product line must be allocated a share of total capacity within its specified limits, and the sum of all capacity shares must equal one.  
To maintain operational flexibility, the manufacturer requires that the group of high-turnover products, represented by the set L = {A, B, C, E, F, H, I, J, K, L, N, O, P, R}, must collectively receive at least 0.843 of the total capacity.  
Additionally, the overall resource consumption of the production plan must not exceed 0.236, and the total expected margin must be at least 0.071.  
Determine the optimal capacity allocation that maximizes total expected margin while satisfying all constraints.
